gitNote: aydy session.rs:57,61 still `label: None` / `jumpable: false`; scan_and_apply still has one non-test caller (reconciler.rs:449)
verbatim: - **The one real defect I found spans REQ-LIST-4 and REQ-LIST-9.** `Session::new` (`/Users/eric/Code/aydy/src-tauri/src/session/session.rs:61`) defaults `jumpable: false` and `label: None`, and both are only ever populated by `reconciler::enrichment` / `apply_reconciliation`, which run on a 25-second `SCAN_INTERVAL` with no scan triggered by an incoming hook (`scan_and_apply` has exactly one non-test caller, the interval loop at reconciler.rs:445). So a freshly started local VS Code session appears under the **"Not jumpable"** header, labelled **"Untitled session"**, for up to 25 s — even though the `SessionStart` hook already supplied its `cwd`. Clicking it in that window also does nothing (`jump/mod.rs:120` bails on `!session.jumpable`). Jumpability genuinely cannot be derived from the hook payload (`HookPayload` in `listener/routes.rs` has no entrypoint field), so `false` is the safe default — but the *label* could use the registry's own `cwd`, and the unknown-jumpability session arguably belongs in "Not yet identified" rather than "Not jumpable". I verified both requirements because their normative rules are implemented and tested, but this transient state is the weakest point in the section.
